title: UnnameApiV2
description: Typen der Sidecar-API v2 – erzeugt, nicht von Hand bearbeiten.

ConfiguredNames.description: Master data from configuration (nightly export) – display only.
ConfiguredNames.title: ConfiguredNames

DocumentLanguageSettings.description:
Document languages and countries.

``languages``: languages to check documents in; the first is the default
for sections without a detectable language. ``per_paragraph``:
detect language per paragraph instead of once per document.
``countries``: numeric IDs and IDs of countries to recognize –
independent of language. ``placeholders_in_document_language``:
placeholders and invented names in the paragraph's language instead of the app's.
DocumentLanguageSettings.title: DocumentLanguageSettings

EntryExport.description:
A storage in the export history.

Time, masking (method, style, categories), target folder, filenames,
labels, and review data – never a value. The last storage is additionally
stored as before in ``Entry.saved_at``, ``output_dir`` and
``EntryFile.output``.
EntryExport.title: EntryExport

EntryReportResponse.description:
Report of a saved entry: counters and review data, never the content.

The wording matches the UI surface (``export/pruefbericht.ts``); only factual data is
provided here.
EntryReportResponse.title: EntryReportResponse

EntryView.description: View state per entry; offsets count UTF-16 code units (spec §2).
EntryView.title: EntryView

ExportedFile.description: A file from a storage in the export history – like ``FileOutput``, but content-free.
ExportedFile.title: ExportedFile

FileOutput.description:
Data stored when saving a file – counters and check info only.

Basis for the “Saved” view and the check report (spec §5). No value,
replacement, or text excerpt.
FileOutput.title: FileOutput

FindingAssessment.description: Assessment by the local AI regarding a question (second opinion).
FindingAssessment.title: FindingAssessment

LayoutCellStyle.description: A cell style of the table model; missing fields mean default values.
LayoutCellStyle.title: LayoutCellStyle

LayoutPagedEngine.description: Office engine that generated the pages.
LayoutPagedEngine.title: LayoutPagedEngine

LayoutPagedResponse.description:
Page-faithful Word view: pages from the PDF of the Office engine.

``original`` is the cleaned copy, ``result`` is the DOCX that would
write the save for the apply state ``revision``. The words
carry ranges in the **source text** – in the result, replacement text lies
over the range of its position.
LayoutPagedResponse.title: LayoutPagedResponse

LayoutSheet.description: A sheet in the grid: dimensions and features; cells are handled separately.
LayoutSheet.title: LayoutSheet

LayoutSheetRowsResponse.description: Cells of a sheet for a row range (``GET /jobs/{id}/layout/sheets/{i}``).
LayoutSheetRowsResponse.title: LayoutSheetRowsResponse

LayoutUnit.description: A text unit (paragraph) in the flow of a Word document.
LayoutUnit.title: LayoutUnit

MaskingDefaults.description:
Default masking for new entries.

Without ``anonymize``: derived and never stored.
MaskingDefaults.title: MaskingDefaults

MaskingSpec.description: The masking spec – identical in frontend and sidecar.

categories.description: Kategorie-IDs aus GET /catalog; gesperrte sind immer dabei.

anonymize.description: Abgeleitet: irreversibel und alle Kategorien. Wird geprueft, nie geraten.

MaskingSpec.title: MaskingSpec

OutputsRequest.description: The shell reports where it has published. Only now does “saved” apply.
OutputsRequest.title: OutputsRequest

PlacementOut.description: How the export draws a placement.
PlacementOut.title: PlacementOut

PlacementText.description: Replacement text as the export sets it – anchors in the display space.
PlacementText.title: PlacementText

SaveEntryRequest.description:
“Save all n files”: the final state shown by the UI.

Open questions are always masked regardless of ``review.unresolved``.
If a file is missing in ``files``, its last recorded review state applies.
SaveEntryRequest.title: SaveEntryRequest

SecondOpinionSettings.description:
Second opinion (local classifier).

Active only if the model is installed (``/models``: ``classifier``).
SecondOpinionSettings.title: SecondOpinionSettings
